newsitem.title: USA: DHL Worldwide opens new Chicago, Miami facilities.
newsitem.headline: DHL Worldwide opens new Chicago, Miami facilities.

text.p: DHL Worldwide Express said it has opened new facilities in Chicago and Miami this week to cope with expanding demand for both express and logistics products.

The new 70,000 sq ft centre at Chicago's O'Hare Airport includes a service centre as well as a bonded gateway with both import and export capability. The new building doubles DHL's existing operation at O'Hare, and includes 50,000 sq ft of warehouse space.
The new materials handling system will be able to handle up to 75 percent more traffic, DHL said in a statement.
The building also is designed to accommodate the growth of DHL's heavier shipments. DHL said its Chicago traffic has grown by over 25 percent in recent years.
The volume of heavier traffic has increased 31 percent in the past three years, said Richard Pointek, the company's director of midwestern U.S. sales.
As part of the expansion here, the company will add 10 road routes to the area network and hire an additional 30 employees.
DHL also said it has opened an 8,000 sq ft logistics centre at Miami International Airport to accommodate the growing demand for specialized logistics services in the Latin America market.

The Miami facility includes a temperature controlled area and in-house customs clearance capability, and will enable the express company to provide a comprehensive list of logistics services including inventory management, warehousing, packaging and labelling. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel +44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017
